precepts.text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing. You can't be outside this school robbing, stealing, lying, using drugs, whatever little secret things you have going on. Why lack of nothing? Because people are going to look out for you in the world: this is a good brother, a good sister right here.
precepts.point: Not only the Jews, but many also of other nations, took great indignation, and were much grieved for the unjust murder of the man, because Onias had a good report even among the other nations. The king was heartily sorry, and moved to pity, and wept, because of the sober and modest behaviour of him that was dead; and being kindled with anger, he took away Andronicus his purple, rent off his clothes, led him through the whole city unto that very place where he had committed impiety against Onias, and there slew he the cursed murderer. Thus the Lord rewarded him his punishment, as he had deserved.
precepts.why:
Somebody might say a good report with them that are without is only for somebody that desires the office of a bishop. No: “That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.”

You have to walk honestly toward them that are without the truth. You can't be outside the school, outside this truth, robbing, stealing, lying, using drugs, whatever little secret things you have going on.

Why “lack of nothing”? Because people are going to look out for you out there in the world. They are going to say, now this is a good dude, this is a good sister right here. That is what Onias had: a sober and modest behaviour that even the other nations honored, so that when he was slain without cause, they complained with the Jews.

precepts.why:
Peter tells the husbands to “dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel”. Nobody understands what that honour means. The women think it means give me mercy, I'm a woman, I'm the weaker vessel, let me mess up. And some of the men think that too. Paul shows one portion of what it really is: “That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour”.

First, that is talking about you. This body is your vessel, and you need to know how to possess it. But when you get a wife, you take her into your possession, and now you possess her vessel too, because woman came from man. So “his vessel” is your body and her body, and both are to be kept in sanctification, cleansing, and in honour.

The sisters need to examine themselves in reverence and get in line. But brothers, we are the ones with the preeminence to make that happen. A man cannot sit back and wait her out, hoping she leaves so the unbelieving can depart; that is evil as hell too. Dwelling with her according to knowledge means taking hold of your own vessel and hers and making the house right.

note.label: Psalm 47: God the Great King Over All the Earth

precepts.why:
“God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.” That shout and trumpet is the last trump: “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

Christ descends from heaven with a shout and the trump of God, the dead in Christ rise first, and then the living are caught up in the clouds. “Wherefore comfort one another with these words.” That is what is in the shout and the sound of the trumpet: our King coming, which is why we sing praises to him.

note.label: Soul Searchers Looking for a Purpose

precepts.why:
It’s not your purpose to sleep with another man’s wife, or another woman’s husband. That’s not what you were put here for, to get yours. “For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication.” What does the Bible say you’re supposed to do? Abstain from fornication: abstinence.

“That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour.” Why? Because you have a purpose. You’re supposed to possess your vessel in sanctification and honour, and walk with integrity. Somebody tries to holler at you, you let them know: I’m married, it is what it is. Let it be known; let them know you stand for something.

Because if you leave that door open, especially to a no good negro, he’ll knock on that door every day: good morning beautiful, I see you changed your hair. He’ll drop that nugget and leave. And them work husbands, and the sister on the job: I can’t reach that up there, you so tall and strong, look at them shoulders. My wife don’t tell me my shoulders look good, and you put a little flex into it.

You don’t realize Satan is messing with you, trying to see what way he can get in. You’ll have real issues going on up front, financially, sickness, death in the family, and in the background Satan is working on you, because he’s got that sister trying to holler at you every day and that dude trying to holler at you at the job every day. Something bad happens up front, and you fall into the arms of that dude or the arms of that woman. You’re supposed to be walking around keeping your body in sanctification and honour.

“Now the works of the flesh are manifest”. We are vessels where the Holy Spirit is supposed to dwell and sanctify us, but these are the works of the flesh, what we are dealing with in pornography and fornication. “Adultery, fornication, uncleanness”: you are no longer holy or sanctified. “Lasciviousness”: looking at another man’s wife or another woman’s husband, looking at a man the way you look at a woman, looking at a child: wicked, evil sexual desires.

“Hatred”: you start hating your brother because you cannot get yourself right, hating what he has and how he got his family in order. “Murders”: the woman you met on the internet is only there because you paid her, and she laughs at you because you are sexually inadequate and socially awkward; then a murderous spirit comes on you and you kill her because she does not want you like you want her. “Drunkenness”: you have to get drunk to talk to a woman. “Revellings”: you go to the party where everybody is promiscuous because it is easy.

“They which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.” We all want the kingdom of God, but if we deal in the lust of the flesh we will not inherit it. So before you go to that porn site, before you go on OnlyFans, before you go where the prostitutes are, consider this. That is why the will of God is that we abstain from fornication.

There is an out. You have time to be watching porn because you do not do enough in the body or for yourself: get busy in the work, go to the gym, get a real job. Too much idle time brings sin; idleness is Satan’s playground.

“There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able”. The Lord will give you that out if you are sincere and trying to get your life right. It may be a brother calling you just when you are about to do that evil: the Lord will send somebody your way to get you out of it.

“But will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.” All brothers burn; that burn is real for the single brother. But the Lord will provide an out so that you do not give in to the temptation, because he is merciful and will help you if you are sincere. That is how you can abstain from fornication.

The key is to be sincere and confess. A lot of us deal with pride and are ashamed of confessing, but we are all sick in here, and we all come to be healed by the word of the Lord and helped by our leadership.

“Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed.” If you confess that you are dealing with it, we are able to pray for that iniquity or impurity; we cannot pray for it if we do not know. Then you begin to heal and move away from the porn and the fornication.

“The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.” The prayer of our leadership, and of the brothers and sisters, will heal you up. There is power behind it, so do not minimize it.

The first resurrection. “Concerning them which are asleep”: those that died in this truth. “That ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope”: like your grandmother who loved the picture of a white man on the wall; she loved the image of the beast. “We which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep”: Paul is saying about himself, I am going to be there; he sees something in the spirit. “And the dead in Christ shall rise first”: that is the first resurrection. “Wherefore comfort one another with these words”: we have to believe we will see them again. If all those prophecies about slavery came to pass, this one about the resurrection will too.

“He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.” That is the mentality we all have to have when people are reproaching us for the name of Christ. It is not you that they hate; it is the spirit of God they see within you. That man and that woman have the Holy Spirit, and I can't stand it because I ain't got it. Oh, it's not hatred, it's correction: I wish you'd die. That's what they do.

precepts.why: This is how we’re going to escape. “The dead in Christ shall rise first”. “Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds”: who is the we? This includes the apostle Paul. He’s telling you about himself prophetically: in the last days I’m going to be there. Paul already saw that thing in the spirit; that’s why in Corinthians he said he went to the third heaven and saw things unlawful for him to utter. The church calls this the rapture, a Latin word that is not in the Bible; it’s the catching away. “Wherefore comfort one another with these words.”

We shall not all sleep: everybody’s not going to be dead when Christ returns. “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first”: because there’s going to be some Israelites that’s already dead.

“Then we which are alive and remain”: there’s going to be a group that’s alive. That’s what we read in Zechariah: that one third is the group that’s going to be alive when Christ returns. So some of us are going to die, and some of us are destined to be alive when Christ returns. “Shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

“Wherefore comfort one another with these words.” These are words of comfort. Don’t worry about death; the dead in Christ are going to rise first. When that tribulation really kicks in, when World War Three pops off, don’t be afraid. Understand what’s going to happen.

“And the trumpet shall give a sound”: “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air”.

“The men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth”: that’s what Paul was talking about right there. “And the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain”: we which are alive, that’s Paul speaking, Paul included, “shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air”. So now we know what 2 Esdras 6:26 is talking about: that group of men that is going to be alive when the Lord returns.

“For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first”. What are you scared for, brothers, sisters? The Bible says the dead gonna rise first.

“Then we which are alive and remain”: didn’t we just read that in Esdras, whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape and see my salvation? “Shall be caught up together with them in the clouds”, because the dead are going to be with Christ in the clouds already. When it says you’re going to come up from the grave, it ain’t talking about down here: remember in Ecclesiastes it says the spirit of man goes up. So when it talks about coming out of the graves, it’s talking about the chambers in the heavens. “To meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord. Wherefore comfort one another with these words.”

note.label: The Song Of Moses & The Song Of The Lamb

precepts.why: The earth shall cast out the dead: “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.” The dead in Christ shall rise first.

This shows what is going to happen as we come through the fire. “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God”: the same archangel we read about in Daniel 12.

“And the dead in Christ shall rise first”: this is what they call a rapture. It means those brothers and sisters that died are going to come back alive.

“Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds”: we are not going into a rain cloud and standing in the midst of it. The cloud here is a chariot. What this world calls UFOs, the Bible calls a cloud, or chariots.

“To meet the Lord in the air”: when Christ comes back he is coming back with chariots, and he is going to be in the air, and we are going to meet him in the air. “And so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

“That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour.” The vessel is the body: this vessel. In sanctification and honour, a vessel of honour. Now we have insight into what Paul means by vessels and honour in Timothy: the body that is purged and sanctified.

moments.label: Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

points: Concerning them which are asleep, sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. If you die in Christ, you are not like those with no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him. If you die right now and you are doing what is right, you are not really dead; the Lord is going to bring you back.

Wherefore comfort one another with these words. These words, the word of God, is what you need in your thoughts. We are not going to be around you all the time; sometimes you might get depressed, might feel like giving up, and Satan will be whispering in your ear, God does not care about you, why is God allowing you to die. You have to learn to comfort yourself with these words.

That ye may walk honestly. You claim to be a follower of Christ, and now you are caught, and it is going everywhere through your whole community; the church mother in that video is going to have to face her church. Those are the same ones who afterward will curse us out on the corner: why are you picking on me, go bother the white neighborhood, do not judge me. Listen, if we do not stop you now, you could go to jail; that was stealing, and that could have been someone's bill money. Your integrity is out the window. Now imagine brothers and sisters in Israel doing the same thing, and the videos catch you: no, I did not take that phone, that was not me. Do not be caught like that. Stay on your A game; your words and your actions must match.

note.label: Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

points: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout: the Lord is going to make his advent, his second coming.

And the dead in Christ shall rise first: all the cemeteries throughout the earth aren't gonna be rattling and shaking and dead bones coming out, looking like Halloween. That's not what it's talking about. Those that died in Christ in the past will return with Christ, according to Jude verse 14.

Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds: that's where the concept of the word rapture comes from. Being caught up in the air with Christ and the saints, with Christ and the dead Israelites.
So the question is, who is the we that will be caught up? Who is the we that Paul was talking to?
Then we which are alive: the Thessalonians, the Jews. To meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

“For this is the will of God, even your sanctification”: your holiness, your cleansing. Evil cannot dwell in a defiled temple; the Holy Spirit will flee fornication. “That ye should abstain from fornication”.

To abstain is to choose not to do or have something; to refrain deliberately, and often with an effort of self-denial, from an action or practice. You have to be deliberate: delete the apps from your phone and the porn sites from your computer, put a lock on it, have a brother create a password so you cannot get in, and use it only for the Lord’s work. It is easy access and free now, so be deliberate. It will not happen on its own and you will not suddenly be super strong; you have to put effort into self-denial of the fleshly lusts and self-gratifications like pornography and masturbation. Pornography leads to masturbation; nobody watches porn for the cinematography. The action is masturbating; the practice is pornography and prostitution, buying women, going on OnlyFans.

“That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour”. You have to know how to possess the vessel God gave you, in holiness and honor. It was not given to you for self-gratification, masturbation, pornography and fornication; it was given for a purpose: to go and teach the people, to heal the broken people, to preach deliverance. If you are into pornography, masturbation, prostitution or soliciting, you cannot do the work. You will be a hypocrite, you will feel guilty, and you will start separating yourself: I’m not feeling well, I can’t make it to camp. We have to let the Holy Spirit dwell in us, not the demonic entities pornography brings.

“Not in the lust of concupiscence”. Concupiscence is strong desire, especially sexual desire: the burning desire you get when you want to watch porn and gratify yourself. “Even as the Gentiles which know not God”: the other nations that do not know God. We cannot be like them. You dishonor the body God gave you when you deal in pornography, fornication and masturbation. These are the scriptures we have to read to bring us out of the abyss, out of the depressed spirit and the evil concupiscence that comes over us when we are alone, without the unity and strength of the body.

“As we also have forewarned you and testified.” This is a forewarning and a testimony: stop dealing in pornography, fornication and masturbation. It only leads to depression and to worse sins; there are levels to it. A homosexual spirit, a lesbian spirit, bestiality, looking at children as sexual objects: all these things come when you deal in pornography.
